title: Replacement and Expedited Shipping Fees Credited With Final Claim Credits, Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite
content:
On the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite plans, the replacement card fees credited with a final credit follow the replacement ordered on the claim's report day.

A claim's report day is its notice date when Paystride ordered a replacement card for a lost or stolen card on the account that day, and the claim is the most recently registered claim of its loss first reported that day. The replacement read is the stolen-card order when both a lost-card and a stolen-card replacement were ordered that day. A day with two replacement orders of the same reason is no report day. A claim's loss is the account's unauthorized-transaction claims carrying its loss date.

| Replacement read on the report day | Credited |
|---|---|
| card replaced as stolen | the replacement fee and the expedited shipping fee charged on that order, less any part of them already returned |
| card replaced as lost | the replacement fee charged on it, less any part already returned; the expedited shipping fee stays the cardholder's |
| no report day | nothing |

Replacement card fees counted under the final claim credit schedule for the Premier and Elite plans are returned within the final credit it prices, not by a separate refund or correction.

*Hypothetical (Elite: replacement fee 0.00, expedited shipping 10.00):* a stolen-card order shipped expedited credits 10.00, and a lost-card order shipped expedited credits nothing.
